name: FrameBudgetProcessor
src_typeComment: Enqueue(action) instead of doing a big batch of work in one frame — spreads it across multiple frames to avoid a hitch. Good for spawning/initializing many objects at once, processing a large save-file migration, or generating a big procedural grid. Not a Singleton — add one per queue if you need independently-paced budgets for different kinds of work.

src_serialized.name: maxActionsPerFrame
src_serialized.tooltip: Maximum number of queued actions run per frame.
